about: Scripture events that no Wayfinder chapter supplies, and notes added to imported events (DESIGN.md section 3, Q15).

events.title: Adam blesses his posterity at Adam-ondi-Ahman
events.summary: Three years before he died, Adam gathered his righteous descendants in the valley of Adam-ondi-Ahman. He gave them his last blessing. D&C 116 names Spring Hill, Missouri, as Adam-ondi-Ahman.
